name: Juggling
short_description: Learn to juggle with animated lessons (NL/FR/EN)
long_description: Step-by-step juggling animations for the Fri3d Badge 2026. Inspired by Juggling Lab's beginner curriculum and solo tricks: 3-cascade, 3-tricks, 4-fountain, and 5-cascade drills with a live siteswap animator. UI in Dutch, French, and English.
